radiology_report:
Radiology Division | Erasmus MC University Medical Center | 15 February 2025
Prostate Multiparametric MRI

Clinical Context:
Rising PSA (7.5 ng/mL) alongside a previously positive biopsy.

Observations:
Measured at 42.0 mL, the gland contains a discrete, hypointense focus in the right peripheral zone at mid-gland, spanning 14 x 11 x 10 mm. Diffusion restriction is evident on DWI, mirrored by low ADC signal. Early focal enhancement appears on dynamic contrast sequences compared to adjacent tissue. Seminal vesicles remain clear. There is no extraprostatic spread or suspicious nodal involvement. Bladder and rectal walls are unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right peripheral zone mid-gland.
Prostate volume 42.0 mL; PSA density 0.179 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.0.
